series.name: Current Sharing Module
series.description:
FB-1254YMDG product is specially designed for applications requiring multi-module redundant current sharing in on-board power systems. When a single power supply fails, it can be automatically disconnected without affecting the operation of other modules. This product is suitable for: applications requiring redundancy, parallel power increase, etc.


Note: Maximum current automatic current sharing mode means that among n modules in parallel, the module with the largest output current automatically becomes the master module, and the remaining modules become slave modules. Their error voltages are sequentially adjusted to correct load current distribution imbalance.
